source: Redken Color Gels Lacquers Paper Chart (official)

numbering_system.description: Redken Color Gels Lacquers uses a letter-based tone code appended to the level number. Creative shade names are used alongside codes.

lines.name: Color Gels Lacquers
lines.description: High saturation permanent liquid lacquer color with 100% grey coverage

10_vol.use: Deposit only, tone-on-tone, grey coverage, darker coloring

20_vol.use: 1-2 levels of lift, grey coverage, standard permanent color service

30_vol.use: 2-3 levels of lift, resistant hair, maximum grey coverage on resistant hair

40_vol.use: Maximum lift, high-lift blonde shades, resistant grey hair

gray_coverage.rule: 100% grey coverage on all Color Gels Lacquers shades
gray_coverage.nn_series: Double Neutral (NN) shades provide extra coverage for resistant grey hair
gray_coverage.resistant_hair: Use 30-40 volume developer for resistant grey hair
gray_coverage.processing_time: 30-35 minutes standard; up to 40 minutes for resistant grey

grey_coverage.standard: 100% on all shades with appropriate developer
grey_coverage.resistant: Use NN series or increase developer volume
grey_coverage.processing: 30-35 min standard; extend to 40 min for resistant

processing_times.grey_coverage: 30-35 minutes; up to 40 minutes for resistant grey
